Hi Sanjay — thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap from our call and the asks we captured so your team can confirm: 

- Service profile you described: 3k peak qps inference bursts, steady-state ~150 qps, 200ms tail-latency SLO for user-facing features.
- Data posture: EU residency requirement + token-level PII masking for telemetry; preference to avoid multi-tenant co-mingling for sensitive prompts.
- Migration origin: currently using a mix of Anthropic API + an internal legacy GPU cluster (decommission planned Q4 2027).
- Initial hosting preference: Dedicated capacity (reserved pool) with VPC peering and optional KMS integration; you flagged private/on-prem as contingency for deeper compliance needs.

As next steps I propose:
1) Confirm that Dedicated + VPC peering meets your security baseline (you mentioned wanting HSM/KMS integration).
2) Schedule a 60-min technical workshop next week with Rishi to drill throughput/latency tests and run profiling on a representative prompt set.
3) Share your procurement timeline / PO process so Priyom can prepare pricing/term options and an initial mutual action plan.

I attached a short Dedicated configuration brief and moved the draft mutual action plan into Excel so we can populate milestones. If Dedicated looks like a fit after the tech workshop, we’ll outline a canary migration path (traffic split -> perf validation -> cutover) and estimate lift-and-shift effort from your cluster.

Can you confirm hosting preference (Dedicated vs Private) and availability for a workshop next Tue/Wed?

Thanks,
Aisha
Aisha Rahman | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Hi Sanjay — quick technical reply to the two main asks: KMS/HSM and cost sizing.

KMS/HSM and networking
- Redwood Dedicated supports customer-managed keys via KMS integrations (AWS KMS, Google Cloud KMS) and HSM-backed keystores for Private/on-prem installs. For a VPC peering + Dedicated scenario we can optionally terminate encryption at the host and enable an HSM-backed envelope key you control. We’ve worked with other customers to run a separate HSM appliance across the peered network. I’ll pull our HSM design note into the drive link below.

Compliance artifacts
- SOC 2 Type II: yes — we can share our latest attestation once an NDA is in place. Log retention and audit logs are configurable per-customer; we can set 12 months retention and provide audit exports for your compliance team.

Performance / cost sketch (ballpark)
- For the workload you described (~3k peak qps bursts, 150 steady) we typically recommend a Dedicated pool sized around 8-10 A100-equivalent GPUs with autoscale buffer to hit tail-latency SLOs under burst patterns.
- Ballpark monthly committed cost (Reserved) for that pool: $110k–$160k/mo depending on region, model choice, and quantization profile. We’ll refine after the profiling workshop.

Suggested next steps
1) Schedule the 60-min workshop (Rishi + infra lead + sample prompt set).
2) Priyom will draft a mutual action plan with target milestones and procurement windows.
3) We’ll prepare SOC2 and HSM reference docs (will share under NDA).

I attached a short security summary and included a proposed canary cadence: week-0 baseline tests, week-1 canary (10% traffic), week-2 validation and gradual ramp. If you need an on-prem/private package instead of Dedicated, we can scope that as an alternative but it usually adds ~6–8 weeks for deployment and HSM wiring.

Rgds,
Rishi Malhotra | Head of Applied ML Ops, Redwood Inference
